title: Statichost.eu – European static site hosting
summary: Statichost.eu is a European-based static site hosting service that provides simple, fast, and GDPR-compliant hosting for static websites. The service garnered significant attention on Hacker News with 310 points and 130 comments, indicating strong community interest in European hosting alternatives.
problem_solved: Provides a privacy-focused, GDPR-compliant alternative for hosting static websites with European data residency.
why_valuable: Offers European hosting infrastructure for developers seeking data sovereignty and compliance without sacrificing performance or simplicity.
